name: Main Library
description: Quiet study areas, group rooms, and access to academic resources.
accessibility_notes: Wheelchair accessible entrance and lift access available.

name: Student Services Centre
description: Help with registration, ID cards, student support, and general enquiries.
accessibility_notes: Step-free access and accessible service desk.

name: Innovation Hub
description: A flexible space used for workshops, talks, and society activities.
accessibility_notes: Accessible entrance and nearby accessible toilets.

name: Sports Centre
description: Campus sports facility with courts, gym, and changing rooms.
accessibility_notes: Step-free access throughout. Accessible changing facilities available.

name: Sports Hall
description: Large indoor hall used for basketball, volleyball, and other indoor sports.
accessibility_notes: Wheelchair accessible. Wide entrance doors and accessible seating.

name: Campus Track
description: Outdoor running track open to all students for casual and structured training.
accessibility_notes: Open outdoor space. Some surfaces may be uneven.

name: PE Hall
description: Multi-use hall within the Sports Hall, used for large events and cultural activities.

name: Wellness Centre
description: Student wellbeing hub offering counselling, mindfulness sessions, and mental health support.
accessibility_notes: Step-free access. Private consultation rooms available.

name: Health Centre
description: On-campus health service providing nurse consultations, and health workshops.
accessibility_notes: Fully accessible. Hearing loop available at reception.

name: Careers Office
description: Career guidance, CV reviews, mock interviews.

name: Main Hall
description: Large multi-purpose hall used for fairs, presentations, and major campus events.
accessibility_notes: Fully accessible. Level entrance and with alot accessible seating available.

name: Student Union Hall
description: Social hub run by the Students Union, hosting events, societies, and community activities.
accessibility_notes: Accessible entrance. Accessible toilets on ground floor.

name: T-Main
description: General purpose teaching building, Main block.

name: T-North
description: Newer teaching building, Newer block with a bigger number of labs.
accessibility_notes: Lift access available in north building.
